# Bridgit

> > Construction workforce planning and resource management platform helping contractors optimize staffing, forecasting, and project allocation.

Bridgit provides workforce intelligence solutions including Bridgit Bench for construction companies to manage labor resources, improve project planning, and address industry labor shortages. The platform integrates with Procore and serves markets including North America and ANZ.

## Key Topics

- Bridgit Bench
- Workforce planning
- Resource management
- Construction project management
- Labor forecasting
- Construction technology
- Procore integration
- Risk management
- OSHA compliance
- Construction careers
- Resource allocation
- Workforce intelligence
- Construction software
- Project scheduling
- Labor shortage solutions
